title: Analyzing Learned Convnet Features with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Models
abstract: arXiv:1702.07189v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (Convnets) have achieved good results in a range of computer vision tasks the recent years. Though given a lot of attention, visualizing the learned representations to interpret Convnets, still remains a challenging task. The high dimensionality of internal representations and the high abstractions of deep layers are the main challenges when visualizing Convnet functionality. We present in this paper a technique based on clustering internal Convnet representations with a Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model, for visualization of learned representations in Convnets. Our method copes with the high dimensionality of a Convnet by clustering representations across all nodes of each layer. We will discuss how this application is useful when considering transfer learning, i.e.\ transferring a model trained on one dataset to solve a task on a different one.

translated_title: 利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型分析卷积神经网络学习到的特征
translated_abstract: 卷积神经网络近年来在一系列计算机视觉任务中取得了良好的效果。尽管备受关注，但通过可视化学习到的表征来解释卷积神经网络仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。内部表征的高维度以及深层网络的高抽象性是可视化卷积神经网络功能时的主要挑战。本文提出了一种基于狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型对卷积神经网络内部表征进行聚类的方法，用于可视化卷积神经网络中学习到的表征。我们的方法通过对每一层所有节点的表征进行聚类来应对卷积神经网络的高维度问题。我们还将讨论这一方法在迁移学习场景中的应用价值，即把在一个数据集上训练的模型迁移到解决另一个数据集上的任务。
tldr: 提出了一种利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型对卷积神经网络各层内部表征进行聚类的新方法，实现了对卷积网络学习特征的可视化解释，并有助于迁移学习分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a technique using Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Models to cluster internal Convnet representations across layers, enabling visualization and interpretation of learned Convnet features, particularly useful for transfer learning analysis.
